profile_text.body:
Technology Innovation Institute (TII) is a government research laboratory based in Abu Dhabi, UAE. The institute describes itself as a leading global advanced technology research center focused on providing science and technology solutions, with work spanning areas including artificial intelligence and autonomous systems such as unmanned aerial vehicles.

TII's primary AI product is Falcon, an open-source large language model released under the Apache 2.0 license. Falcon is hosted in the UAE, positioned as a sovereign AI offering with Middle East data residency, and is tracked in the Chat and General LLMs category. The held facts confirm TII is a non-profit government laboratory, with no recorded litigation or MCP server presence at this time.
